# hri_server (Data Source)

Reads one dedicated server from the Robot account inventory.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    hri = { source = "withlogicco/hri" }
  }
}

provider "hri" {}

data "hri_server" "containership_01" {
  server_number = 161051
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_number` (Number) Robot server number to read.

### Read-Only

- `cancelled` (Boolean)
- `dc` (String)
- `ips` (List of String)
- `paid_until` (String)
- `product` (String)
- `server_ip` (String)
- `server_ipv6_net` (String)
- `server_name` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `subnets` (List of String)
- `traffic` (String)
